AssertArgs.description: Args for [`Assert`]: a scalar predicate `actual <op> expected` (± tolerance).

actual.description: The measured value (typically threaded in from an upstream metric).

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance applied to the comparison (default 0). Band semantics: `Ge`/`Gt` relax the bound to `expected - tolerance`; `Le`/`Lt` relax it to `expected + tolerance`; `Eq`/`Ne` treat `|actual - expected| <= tolerance` as equal. Note a `NaN` `actual` fails every predicate except `Ne` (NaN is unequal to everything) — intentional: an unmeasured value never satisfies a data-quality floor.

OnBreach.description: How a check treats a breach. `Block` fails the node (fail-closed — the executor skips every downstream); `Warn` records a lineage breach event and passes through so the DAG continues.

CheckJsonlArgs.description: Args for [`CheckJsonl`]: row-count bounds + breach policy.

max_rows.description: Maximum row count (inclusive). `None` = no upper bound.

min_rows.description: Minimum row count (inclusive). `None` = no lower bound.

extra_env.description: Extra child-process env as `KEY=VALUE` strings, set BEFORE python starts so DataLoader fork-workers inherit it. Load-bearing for the detail-band selection is intentionally excluded here: use the typed `detail_bands`/`detail_stack_mode` fields so admission and the trainer derive one identical input shape.

lambda_rate.description: Rate loss weight (λ in D + λR). Default 0.01.

latent_dim.description: `--latent-dim <int>`: FSQ latent channels (ADR 0045). `None` ⇒ no flag ⇒ the trainer uses the PRESET's `cfg.latent_dim` (e1/MONITOR = 32, l1 = 64). Set explicitly to override the preset (e.g. 96/128 for the CLINICAL teacher).

line_length_weight.description: `--line-length-weight <float>` (ADR 0063): amplitude-invariant line-length (morphology) loss weight — high-freq texture without fitting noise. Off (0).

nnodes.description: Multi-node DDP: number of nodes (with `nproc_per_node` per node). `None`/ `Some(1)` = single-node. World size = nnodes × nproc_per_node. Requires a cluster launcher (Slurm) to set MASTER_ADDR / NODE_RANK per node.

no_resume.description: Durable-resume override: force a FRESH start even when a resumable recovery checkpoint exists for this config. The trainer still writes recovery checkpoints (so a later kill is resumable); this only suppresses the auto-resume DECISION for this run.

nproc_per_node.description: torchrun `--nproc_per_node`: number of DDP ranks (GPUs) for ONE job. `None`/`Some(1)` = single-process (byte-identical to before). `Some(n)` launches n ranks data-parallel via NCCL. PARTICIPATES IN THE CACHE KEY: per-rank batch is fixed, so the effective GLOBAL batch (and the trained output) scales with nproc. The stage requests `nproc` GPU permits (`gpu_permits`) and scales the RAM footprint ×nproc.

parallel_strategy.description: Multi-GPU parallel strategy: `None`/`Ddp` (default — replicate, the historical path; emits NO extra argv so existing specs are byte-identical) or `Fsdp` (FSDP2 fully_shard — shard encoder/decoder params/grads/optim state, ZeRO-3). Only meaningful when `nproc_per_node > 1`. PARTICIPATES IN THE CACHE KEY (it changes the trained artifact's sharding/save path). A typed enum so a typo is rejected at deserialize time, not at the Python CLI boundary.

preset.description: `--config` preset (fast | medium | production). LamQuant uses TrainingConfig presets.

resume.description: Optional explicit `--resume <path>` (or "auto"). Empty = let durable resume (Phase D) decide. A non-empty value is an OPERATOR OVERRIDE — it resumes from exactly that path and bypasses the crash-gated auto policy.

soap_max_precond_dim.description: `--soap-max-precond-dim <int>`: SOAP full-matrix preconditioner dim cap (the trainer default is 10000; lower to ~2048 to fit big tier-5+ decoders).

ParallelStrategy.description: Multi-GPU parallel strategy. `Ddp` (default) replicates the model per rank; `Fsdp` (FSDP2 fully_shard) shards params/grads/optimizer state (ZeRO-3). A typed enum so an invalid value is rejected at deserialize time rather than silently passed to the Python CLI.

since_seconds.description: How far back to pull, in seconds. Recipes convert humantime strings to seconds before constructing Args so the JsonSchema is a clean integer.

A4: E1 codec-quality-probe args are now TYPED fields above (`encoder_width`, `encoder_blocks`, `encoder_kernels`, `detail_bands`, `detail_stack_mode`, `soap_max_precond_dim`) — set the E1 probe via those, e.g. `encoder_width: 256, encoder_blocks: 12, detail_bands: "all"`, NOT through `extra_args`. (A flag set BOTH here and via a typed field duplicates on the argv; argparse last-wins, but prefer the typed field.) `extra_args` remains the escape hatch for everything else, e.g. `["--epochs-warmup","2","--epochs-quant","0"]`.

extra_env.description: Extra child env as `KEY=VALUE`, set before python starts so DataLoader fork-workers inherit it. Detail-band configuration belongs in the typed `detail_bands` / `detail_stack_mode` fields. Legacy `SNN_DETAIL_BANDS` / `SNN_DETAIL_STACK_MODE` entries are migrated at the recipe boundary and removed before stage preflight.

gan_disc_chunk.description: `--gan-disc-chunk <int>` (ADR 0063): GAN discriminator channel chunk size (now covers ALL channels in chunks; was 4-of-21). Default 7.

grad_accum_steps.description: `--grad-accum-steps <int>`: gradient accumulation (effective batch = batch_size × this). Trainer default is 1.

lambda_rate.description: Rate loss weight (λ in D + λR). Higher = more rate pressure. Default 0.01. Only used when `entropy_model` is true.

lamquant_home.description: LamQuant repo root. Empty = env / default.

latent_dim.description: `--latent-dim <int>`: FSQ latent channels (ADR 0045). `None` ⇒ the trainer uses the preset's `cfg.latent_dim` (e1 = 32, l1 = 64). Set to override.

line_length_weight.description: `--line-length-weight <float>` (ADR 0063): amplitude-invariant line-length (morphology) loss weight — high-freq texture without fitting noise. Off (0).

nnodes.description: Multi-node DDP: number of nodes (with `nproc_per_node` per node). Default single-node. World size = nnodes × nproc_per_node. Requires `--launcher slurm` to set MASTER_ADDR / NODE_RANK per node.

no_resume.description: Durable-resume override: force a FRESH start even if a resumable checkpoint exists for this config (recovery is still written, so a later kill remains resumable). Use to deliberately re-train a config from scratch without deleting its resume dir.

nproc_per_node.description: Single-job multi-GPU (DDP). `None`/`Some(1)` = single-process (default). `Some(n)` trains ONE job data-parallel across n GPUs via torchrun+NCCL. Participates in the cache key (per-rank batch fixed → global batch scales with nproc). On a multi-GPU box this is the way to use all cards for one model; for N independent jobs use `partition backfill` instead.

parallel_strategy.description: Multi-GPU parallel strategy: `None`/`Ddp` (default) or `Fsdp` (FSDP2 fully_shard — shard encoder/decoder state, ZeRO-3). Only meaningful when `nproc_per_node > 1`; threaded recipe → stage → trainer.

resume.description: Explicit `--resume <path>` operator override. Empty = let durable resume (Phase D) decide: a re-run after a crash auto-resumes from the last recovery checkpoint for this exact config; a clean prior run or a new config starts fresh. Requires `LAMQUANT_DATA_ROOT` (the resume dir lives under it); unset ⇒ durable resume is off.

soap_max_precond_dim.description: `--soap-max-precond-dim <int>`: SOAP preconditioner dim cap (trainer default 10000; lower to ~2048 to fit big tier-5+ decoders).

ParallelStrategy.description: Multi-GPU parallel strategy. `Ddp` (default) replicates the model per rank; `Fsdp` (FSDP2 fully_shard) shards params/grads/optimizer state (ZeRO-3). A typed enum so an invalid value is rejected at deserialize time rather than silently passed to the Python CLI.
